thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: GPU queue growth + driver Xid errors in us-west-2 cluster. Paging alice_oncall, ben_sre. Auto-escalation threshold met.

alice_oncall: seeing huge queue backlog on gpu-pool-7, 3x baseline. Customers getting 429s and long tail latencies. Visible since ~09:12 UTC.

ben_sre: confirm. Metrics -> queue_length spiked at 09:11 and steady rise. autoscaler attempted 2 scale-ups, both failed due to node registration timeouts.

cara_eng: logs show repeated "Xid 13" cuda errors on multiple nodes, and some nodes reporting OOMs. Suspect driver/kernel instability reducing effective capacity.

ben_sre: adding snippet from node logs: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:00:1c.0): 13, pid=22456, 0/0
[ 1234.568012] Out of memory: Kill process 22456 (python) total-vm:...kB
```

dmitri_rt: nvidia-smi on node-172 shows multiple processes stuck in Z state and GPU memory pinned: 
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. |
| 0    A100-SXM4    Enabled      | 00000000:00:1A.0 Off | N/A               |
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  PID   Type   Process name                 GPU Memory |
| 22456  C      python                          24000 MiB |
| 22789  C      python                          22000 MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

priya_ops: autoscaler logs: "node registration timed out" and then "scale down inhibited due to recent failover". Looks like autoscale attempts race with driver restarts, causing capacity thrash.

alice_oncall: impact: several customer apps in us-west-2 reporting 5-20% error rates and tail latency > 5s for completions. Sam_cs, please gather which tenants impacted.

sam_cs: pinging customers in incident list, will update slack thread.

ben_sre: mitigation plan proposal: 1) Pause autoscaler for gpu-pool-7 to stop churn. 2) Drain new requests from most-affected pool to a warm fallback pool (gpu-pool-3) with known-stable drivers. 3) Evict stuck processes where possible and cordon 2 flapping nodes. 4) If driver crashes continue, roll driver to previous stable package.

cara_eng: quick commands: 
```
# pause autoscaler for pool
kubectl -n infra annotate gpupool gpu-pool-7 autoscaler.paused=true
# cordon node
kubectl cordon node-172
# force-evict pods (careful):
kubectl delete pod -n runtime --field-selector spec.nodeName=node-172 --grace-period=0 --force
```

alice_oncall: doing step 1 now (annotating autoscaler).

incident-bot: autoscaler annotated: autoscaler.paused=true by alice_oncall at 09:24 UTC.

ben_sre: starting drain routing: updating router policy to prefer gpu-pool-3 for new requests for 30m. This will increase token cost but reduce customer errors.

priya_ops: cordoning node-172 and node-174 — both show frequent Xid entries. Cordon done.

cara_eng: evicting stuck processes on node-172 now. Expect ~30-60s for kernel to clean up.

ben_sre: patching a temporary kernel module param to reduce OOM aggressiveness while investigating (sysctl applied).

alice_oncall: noticed immediate drop in new 429s after router change, tail latencies improving. Queue stopped growing.

ben_sre: still seeing periodic Xid 31/13 from remaining nodes, though lower frequency. Suggest rolling driver on 3 nodes sequentially to avoid full pool outage.

tom_runtime_lead: agree with sequential driver rollback. We'll roll 2 nodes at a time with health checks. Prepare canary on 1 node with high-availability traffic.

cara_eng: creating rollout job, will run pilot on node-180 first. Command: 
```
run-driver-rollout --pool gpu-pool-7 --from v525.60 -> v523.45 --batch 1 --wait 300s
```

priya_ops: starting rollout pilot. Monitoring GPU health and registration.

incident-bot: pagerduty-bot acknowledged and routed to ben_sre and alice_oncall.

sam_cs: updated impacted customer list: tenant-alpha, tenant-beta, partner-gamma. Sent heads-up with mitigation ETA ~20min and fallback reassurance.

alice_oncall: customer-reported degradations are decreasing; keep monitoring. Marking incident as "mitigated" once driver pilot succeeds on canary and autoscaler remains paused.

ben_sre: pilot node registered with new driver v523.45 and passed health checks (latency, nvml errors). Proceeding with 2-node rolling rollback.

cara_eng: rollback batch completed for 6 nodes. No new Xid spikes in last 12 minutes. Queue length trending down to baseline.

ben_sre: re-enabling autoscaler with conservative ramp settings in 15min if no regressions.

alice_oncall: re-enable scheduled for 09:55 UTC with max-step 2 nodes / 10m and cooldown extended.

incident-bot: autoscaler annotated removed by alice_oncall at 09:55 UTC.

priya_ops: autoscaler resumed with conservative config. Watching for new scale events.

ben_sre: postmortem TODOs: - capture exact driver versions + node list - correlate driver regressions with kernel versions - add health check that detects Xid flood earlier (alert before queue grows) - autoscaler backoff adjustments to avoid racing with driver restarts.

sam_cs: I'll follow up with customers and share incident summary once final postmortem available.

alice_oncall: incident status -> mitigated. Moving to follow-up. Thanks all for quick coordination. (reacted with :thumbsup:)

pagerduty-bot: incident closed in PagerDuty at 10:05 UTC by alice_oncall."
